LightningComponentBundle.description: Embeds an arcade game as a microfrontend - a Pixel Cabinet React game or the externally hosted LWC OSS Snake - and reports finished rounds to the page.

property.name: game
property.label: Game
property.description: Which game to show. 'lobby' shows the Pixel Cabinet game picker, where players pick a cabinet game.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Leave empty to use the game's name.

property.name: appUrl
property.label: App URL
property.description: Overrides the App URL of the game record, e.g. with a local dev server. Leave empty to use the record's App URL.
